description:
Lore is a private, voice-first journal that turns spoken memories into an evolving life story.

Record a voice note whenever something feels worth remembering. Lore creates a faithful transcript, then shapes it into a readable journal entry grounded in what you actually said. Your entries build into a personal biography you can revisit over time.

BUILT AROUND YOUR VOICE
• Capture memories by speaking naturally
• Keep the original transcript beside every finished story
• Add names and preferred spellings to your transcription vocabulary
• Choose first- or third-person journal writing
• Store your finished transcripts and stories on your iPhone

HOW PROCESSING WORKS
To provide its core features, Lore sends recordings to Groq for transcription and sends the resulting transcript text to Fireworks AI for journal writing. Lore does not keep recordings, transcripts, or stories in its own server database. Finished transcripts and stories are stored on your iPhone.
promotionalText: Speak naturally. Lore turns your voice notes into faithful transcripts and readable life stories.
